title: GAIA measurement definition
description: Normative shape of ONE reusable ticket-measurement definition. A definition names a fixed, ordered set of numeric values (score mandatory) that a workflow measures and writes into the gaia_ticket.metrics field as namespaced gaia_metric rows.

id.description: Stable machine id of the definition; the metric-name namespace prefix (`<id>.<value_name>`).

label.description: Mandatory human-readable name of the definition.

label_term.description: OPTIONAL. Name of an existing gaia_labels taxonomy term assigned to the ticket on measure as human-visible provenance. Omit it when the namespaced metric name (and, for a sub-work measurement, the ticket's work:* label) already makes the origin clear — then no term is assigned and none needs seeding.

values.description: Fixed, ordered set of numeric values this definition measures. Order is significant (display + write order).

name.description: Machine name of the value; the namespaced metric name is `<definition id>.<name>`. All values are numeric by contract.

label.description: Mandatory human-readable name of this value.

description.description: What the value means / how it is derived.

unit.description: Unit written to gaia_metric.unit (e.g. `ratio`, `count`, `points`). Omit for a bare number.

min.description: Lower bound of the value's expected range.

max.description: Upper bound of the value's expected range.

direction.description: Scoring direction: `up` = higher is better, `down` = lower is better, `neutral` = informational.
